ridgecrest-baptist-greenville-tx.assessment: Ridgecrest Baptist Church in Greenville is exactly the kind of church the directory wants to surface: 60-year-old (founded 1965) conservative SBC congregation, dual-aligned with the Southern Baptists of Texas Convention (the conservative split from BGCT, not the BGCT itself), explicitly adopting Baptist Faith & Message 2000, led by a plurality of male Staff Elders (Nick Dorsey, Joel Bench, Justin Milton) under the polity statement 'ruled by Jesus, led by the Elders, governed by the congregation' — the 9Marks elder-led-congregational pattern. The 'reformed-ish' descriptor the submitter used is well-earned: the doctrinal essentials affirm total depravity, monergistic grace, substitutionary atonement, and perseverance, even though the church does not formally subscribe to the 1689 London Baptist Confession or claim a Founders Ministry affiliation on its public site. Preaching is explicitly verse-by-verse expository, with a sermon archive of 6,321 messages spanning systematic book studies (John, Galatians, Colossians, Ephesians, Habakkuk, Esther, Philemon, 1 Timothy, Hebrews, Psalms, Sermon on the Mount). The 'RidgeMen' men's ministry is dedicated and pastor-led. The local missions arm 'For the City' (launched 2017) and a Spanish-language plant from 1981 demonstrate Great Commission seriousness. Past pastoral roster (Pratt, McGinlay, Hamilton, Stubblefield, Douglass, Herbert, Beasley, now Dorsey) shows stable conservative trajectory. No drift signals, no female pastoral roles above women's ministry, no progressive-justice language. Submitter Ben Collins's characterization — 'fairly conventionally conservative SBC church, led by a reformed-ish pastor with outstanding shepherding and preaching skills... a great opportunity for a strong male community' — is independently corroborated by the church's own published material. Solid GREEN, no qualifiers.

score_notes.christology: Doctrinal statement explicitly affirms Trinity ("One Triune God eternally existent in three persons"), virgin birth, two natures in one Person of Christ, substitutionary atonement, bodily resurrection, ascension, and return in glory — fully Nicene/Chalcedonian.
score_notes.scripture: Verbal plenary inspiration: "the Holy Scriptures are the very Word of God, verbally inspired in all parts and therefore wholly without mixture of error as originally revealed." Adopts BF&M 2000 verbatim. Inerrancy explicit.
score_notes.gender: Male-only elders/pastors confirmed via leadership page (all three Staff Elders are men; only role given to a woman is Minister to Children and Director of Nursery Ministry, consistent with complementarian SBC norm). BF&M 2000 adoption locks in complementarian pastoral office.
score_notes.leadership: Polity explicitly stated: 'We are ruled by Jesus, led by the Elders, and governed by the congregation.' Plurality of male elders (Dorsey, Bench, Milton) with congregational accountability — the textbook elder-led congregational pattern advocated by 9Marks. Pastor answerable to the elder team and to the congregation.
score_notes.soteriology: Reformed-Baptist soteriology in the doctrinal essentials: total depravity ('man... has become separated from, and spiritually dead to God through Adam’s sin... possessing depraved human nature with no spark of divine life'), monergistic grace ('salvation is a free and permanent gift of God that cannot be secured or merited in part or in whole by any virtue or good work of man'), substitutionary atonement, perseverance ('salvation is inextricably bound to righteous living and good works and is the inevitable consequence (not the procuring cause) of the new life implanted by the Holy Spirit'). Faith alone explicit.
score_notes.cultural: No DEI/CRT or progressive-justice framing found anywhere on site. SBTC affiliation is the conservative Texas convention (split from BGCT in 1998 over inerrancy and trajectory). Stated mission language is gospel-centered ('herald... gracious proclamation of the Gospel').
score_notes.preaching: 'Our normal method of teaching is a verse-by-verse study of a book of the Bible.' Expository confirmed. Sermon archive shows 6,321 messages across 58+ series including book studies of John, Galatians, Colossians, Ephesians, Habakkuk, Esther, Philemon, 1 Timothy, Hebrews, Psalms, and Sermon on the Mount — systematic exposition over years.
score_notes.mission: Strong outward focus: 'Grow. Serve. Go.' core. Local missions arm 'For the City' (launched 2017) plus adopted missionaries (Adopted Missions Request form). Hispanic plant in 1981. Great Commission framed as primary purpose statement.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Dedicated 'RidgeMen Ministry' — explicit goal: 'equip men to build Christ-centered relationships through Bible study, service, leadership, and community.' Led by Joel Bench (Pastor of Discipleship). Independent men's page and contact path confirmed.
score_notes.denominational: Dual-aligned SBC + SBTC. SBTC is the conservative-inerrantist alternative to BGCT. Elder plurality plus congregational governance plus dual denominational accountability is among the tightest accountability structures available in SBC life.

river-oak-church.assessment: River Oak Church is a strong SBC option for Hampton Roads-area men. The church plants out of South Norfolk Baptist Church (1998 land purchase, 1999 first service at Oscar F. Smith High School, 2000 formal constitution, 2007 facility opening on Great Bridge Blvd), and adopts the Baptist Faith and Message 2000 verbatim. The doctrinal statement hits every conservative-evangelical mark: triune God, full deity and exclusivity of Christ, inerrant Scripture as 'totally true and trustworthy...without any mixture of error,' salvation by grace through faith alone, believer's baptism by immersion, complementarian marriage and pastoral office ('the office of pastor is limited to men'), and explicit opposition to homosexuality and sexual immorality. Governance is 'Council-Led, Congregational' — a hybrid plural-elder + congregational-vote model where the three Co-Lead Pastors (Hammen, Waldrop, LaRussa, all called 2024) plus four elected male lay councilors function as elders/overseers/pastors and the congregation votes on budgets, officer elections, constitutional amendments, and pastoral calls. Preaching is expository (current series through Titus and Mark). Dedicated Men's Ministry with Men's Groups and the ManCake breakfast confirms intentional men's discipleship. No DEI/CRT or affirming language found on the public pages. Green across all ten dimensions.

The Campus Outreach ministry on staff signals a heart for the next generation.
